summary: Xanadu filed a Form 6-K containing a routine first-quarter 2026 earnings press release. The filing discusses financial results, business milestones, and strategic updates, including a previously completed business combination and ongoing government funding negotiations. No new special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, deal termination, management change, or SPAC business combination—is announced. This is a standard earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
